faq_1_q: Is it complicated to integrate with Facebook and WhatsApp?
faq_1_a: Not at all. Integration is a single click (Login with Facebook), no coding or technical experience needed.
faq_2_q: Can the AI give a wrong price?
faq_2_a: Impossible. Our AI only understands requests; it fetches real prices and inventory from your deterministic catalog.
faq_3_a: Currently, it specializes in Direct Messages (DMs), as it's the actual place for closing sales and taking shipping info.
faq_4_q: Will it understand a randomly written address?
faq_4_a: Yes, this is our strongest feature! Even if messy or in Franco, the model extracts governorate, area, and street perfectly.
faq_5_q: How do I send orders to the shipping company?
faq_5_a: The system collects orders in a ready Excel/Sheets file compatible with shipping companies (Bosta, etc.), you just upload it in seconds.
faq_6_q: Can I intervene and reply myself?
faq_6_a: Of course! Once you reply, the system immediately pauses the automated bot so you can take over the conversation.
